    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_ledger_arm_red_code value = 1001 } }

zg361_workforce_probation_fact_arm_hire_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status

    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_expected_arm_receipt_id
        value = { value = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case multiply = 1000 add = 274 }
    }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_expected_arm_receipt_hash

            value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash
            add = { value = var:zg361_we_m274_write_cycle multiply = 1000 }
            add = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case

    zg361_workforce_probation_fact_prepare_ledger_arm_effect = yes

            }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_subject value = this }

        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_arm_receipt_id

        }

                add = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case

            }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_ledger_arm_append_pending value = 0 }

    else_if = {

            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_arm_receipt_id
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_arm_receipt_hash

            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_state >= 1
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_owner = scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_arm_owner_scope
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_hire_cycle = var:zg361_we_m274_write_cycle
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_hire_case = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_probation_due_cycle = var:zg361_we_m274_probation_due_cycle
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_position_receipt_id = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id

            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_arm_receipt_id = scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_expected_arm_receipt_id
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_arm_receipt_hash = scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_expected_arm_receipt_hash
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status value = 2 } # exact arm replay
    }
    else_if = {

            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_ledger_slot_1_probation_due_cycle

}

# Pending hook 1.  Call immediately after the canonical result settlement
# while current scope is the subject.  Idempotency key:
# owner/subject + hire cycle/case + result cycle/case/state/settlement +
# grade/reason/KPI/rank + three #267 evidence IDs + attribution bps.
zg361_workforce_probation_fact_publish_from_result_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_red_code
    save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_subject_scope
    $OWNER$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_owner_scope }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_expected_attribution_bps_1
        value = {
            value = 10000
            subtract = $ATTRIBUTION_BPS_2$
            subtract = $ATTRIBUTION_BPS_3$
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_state
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_owner
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_subject
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_owner
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_subject
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_cycle
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_case
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_state
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_settlement_receipt
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_grade
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_reason
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_kpi
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_rank
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_outcome_dimension_1
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_outcome_dimension_2
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_outcome_dimension_3
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_attribution_bps_2
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_attribution_bps_3
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_state >= 2
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_owner = scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_owner_scope
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_owner = scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_owner_scope
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_cycle = var:zg361_result_cycle_serial
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_case = var:zg361_result_case_serial
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_state = var:zg361_result_case_state
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_settlement_receipt = var:zg361_result_settlement_posted_serial
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_grade = var:zg361_result_grade
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_reason = var:zg361_result_grade_reason
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_kpi = var:zg361_result_kpi_frozen
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_result_rank = var:zg361_result_rank_frozen
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_outcome_dimension_1 = var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_1
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_outcome_dimension_2 = var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_2
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_outcome_dimension_3 = var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_3
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_attribution_bps_2 = $ATTRIBUTION_BPS_2$
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_attribution_bps_3 = $ATTRIBUTION_BPS_3$
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status value = 2 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_state = 3 }
            zg361_workforce_probation_fact_schedule_consume_effect = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_state = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status value = 4 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_state = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_owner = scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_owner_scope
            var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_subject = this
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_hire_cycle
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_hire_case
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_probation_due_cycle
            has_variable = zg361_result_case_owner
            has_variable = zg361_result_cycle_serial
            has_variable = zg361_result_case_serial
            has_variable = zg361_result_case_state
            has_variable = zg361_result_settlement_posted_serial
            has_variable = zg361_result_grade
            has_variable = zg361_result_grade_reason
            has_variable = zg361_result_kpi_frozen
            has_variable = zg361_result_rank_frozen
            var:zg361_result_case_owner = scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_owner_scope
            var:zg361_result_cycle_serial >= var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_probation_due_cycle
            var:zg361_result_cycle_serial > var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_hire_cycle
            OR = {
                var:zg361_result_case_state = 3
                var:zg361_result_case_state = 5
            }
            var:zg361_result_settlement_posted_serial = var:zg361_result_case_serial
            var:zg361_result_case_serial > 0
            OR = {
                var:zg361_result_grade = 1
                var:zg361_result_grade = 2
                var:zg361_result_grade = 3
            }
            scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_owner_scope = {
                has_variable = zg361_review_serial
                var:zg361_review_serial >= scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_subject_scope.var:zg361_result_cycle_serial
            }
            has_variable = zg361_we_m269_outcome_pending
            var:zg361_we_m269_outcome_pending = 1
            var:zg361_we_m269_write_owner = scope:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_result_owner_scope
            var:zg361_we_m269_write_subject = this

            var:zg361_we_m269_write_state = 5
            var:zg361_we_m274_hire_case = var:zg361_workforce_probation_fact_hire_case

            var:zg361_we_m267_raw_votes_frozen = 1
            has_variable = zg361_we_m267_interviewer_1
            has_variable = zg361_we_m267_interviewer_2
            has_variable = zg361_we_m267_interviewer_3
            NOT = { var:zg361_we_m267_interviewer_1 = var:zg361_we_m267_interviewer_2 }
            NOT = { var:zg361_we_m267_interviewer_1 = var:zg361_we_m267_interviewer_3 }
            NOT = { var:zg361_we_m267_interviewer_2 = var:zg361_we_m267_interviewer_3 }
            has_variable = zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_1
            has_variable = zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_2
            has_variable = zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_3
            var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_1 > 0
            var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_2 > 0
            var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_3 > 0
            NOT = { var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_1 = var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_2 }

            $ATTRIBUTION_BPS_2$ >= 0

        set_variable = {
            name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_attribution_receipt_hash
            value = {
                value = var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_1 multiply = 100000
                add = { value = var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_2 multiply = 1000 }
                add = var:zg361_we_m267_vote_evidence_3
                add = { value = $ATTRIBUTION_BPS_2$ multiply = 10 }
                add = $ATTRIBUTION_BPS_3$
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_result_grade = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_awaiting_pip value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_state value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status value = 3 }
            debug_log = "ZG361WPF: settled 3.25 frozen; real B2 PIP settlement is still required"
        }
        else = {

            zg361_workforce_probation_fact_publish_canonical_effect = yes

    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_red_code value = 2001 }
        debug_log = "ZG361WPF RED 2001: result hook lacks exact hire/result/attribution provenance"
    }

    }
}
